executiveSummary: Apple's Black Friday event offers various deals on Apple products, including the AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max, and Apple TV, while also introducing new features and limitations for AI and CarPlay. The company's iPhone 18 production delay impacts the launch of new iPhone models. Industry shifts and supply chain issues are also present in the news.
